system.name: Drop-off Operations Dashboard & Bot Lab
system.purpose: Real-time diagnostic drop-off tracking, quality control verification, partner order synchronization, challan generation, and automated bulk booking creation across partner diagnostic labs.

modules.name: Operations Overview Hub
modules.description: Central real-time cockpit displaying key performance indicators (KPIs), daily booking volume, total pending drop-offs, QC pendency, client-wise breakdowns, and real-time transit status.
keyMetrics: QC Pending Samples (Awaiting lab technician review)

syncDetails.interval: Automated background sync every 75 seconds from Google Sheets
syncDetails.manualRefresh: Click the sync icon in the top header or press Shift + R
syncDetails.realtimeIndicators: Live green/pulsing sync badge in top bar showing elapsed seconds since last sync

modules.name: Quality Control (QC) Hub
modules.description: Laboratory sample quality check and rejection management module. Allows lab technicians and operations managers to inspect incoming vials, verify barcodes, approve clean samples, or log rejections.
rejectionReasons: Clotted Sample (Blood coagulation in EDTA/Citrate vial)
Hemolysed Sample (Ruptured red blood cells rendering serum unviable)
Insufficient Volume (Quantity not sufficient for automated analyzer run)
Label Mismatch (Discrepancy between TRF and tube barcode)
Wrong Tube / Additive (Sample collected in incorrect vacuum container)
Leaked / Damaged Vial (Compromised container during transit)
Delayed Transit / Temperature Abuse (Cold chain failure exceeding stability threshold)

tubeColorMapping.Red / Yellow (SST): Serum / Clot Activator (Biochemistry, Hormones, LFT, KFT, Lipid Profile, Serology)
tubeColorMapping.Grey: Sodium Fluoride (Fasting Blood Sugar, Post Prandial Glucose)

modules.name: AlloHealth & Fleet Transit
modules.description: Dedicated operations tracking for AlloHealth diagnostic bookings and specialized tele-consult drop-offs.

modules.name: BHMC (Bharath Home Medicare)
modules.description: Specialized drop-off tracking module for Bharath Home Medicare partner network.

modules.name: Medibuddy Drop-Off Embedded Portal
modules.description: Embedded Google Apps Script Web App iframe that connects directly to the Medibuddy order management system.

troubleshooting.whyBlank: The iframe is lazy-loaded on demand when you first click the Medibuddy tab. If it appears blank, click the Reload button or verify your Google Workspace login session.
troubleshooting.corsHandling: Medibuddy uses secure sandbox parameters allowing same-origin scripts, forms, and popups.

modules.name: Dispatch & Challan Generator
modules.description: Automated delivery challan and batch manifest generation tool. Aggregates drop-offs by destination lab, generates barcodes, formats printable PDF manifests, and logs courier handovers.

troubleshooting.printing: Click the Print Challan button within the iframe to launch the native browser print preview.

modules.name: Bot Lab (AI-Powered Autonomous Browser & Booking Suite)
modules.description: Next-generation browser emulation and autonomous bot command suite for bulk partner booking creation on partner diagnostic portals.
features: Dual Execution Modes: 'All-at-Once Parallel Batch' (Grid View) vs 'Step-by-Step 1-by-1 Queue'
Pending Bookings Dispatch Matrix Drawer with multi-selection, partner filters, and 1-click single/batch launch
Chrome-like dynamic tab strip with instant tab creation, focus, reload, and close
Unified Omnibox with navigation controls, SSL lock, URL entry, and 1-click external window bypass
Zero-Reload Tab Architecture: Hidden tabs retain their DOM and script state without reloading when switching tabs
RedcliffeBot Conversational AI: Answers operational queries in Hindi, Hinglish, and English, checks real-time pendency, launches bookings on voice/text commands
Real-time Queue Heads-Up Display (HUD) with progress bars, skip, pause, stop, and retry controls

iframes.name: Primary Bot Browser Frame
iframes.notes: Hosts the partner portal inside the dashboard when the companion extension strips X-Frame-Options.

securityAndHeaders.xFrameOptions: By default, partner.redcliffelabs.com sends 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' and 'Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors', which standard browsers block when embedded in an external domain.
securityAndHeaders.companionExtension: The companion Chrome Extension ('Bisht Ji Ultimate Bot v10.2') uses declarativeNetRequest rules in Manifest V3 to strip X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy headers from partner.redcliffelabs.com, allowing seamless iframe embedding.
securityAndHeaders.externalWindowBypass: If the extension is temporarily disabled or not installed in the active Chrome profile, click the 'Open in External Window' (open_in_new) button on any tab card or in the Omnibox. This opens the exact booking directly in a native browser window, completely bypassing all iframe security headers.

urlParameters.botAutoRun: true (Signals the extension to immediately begin form-filling and submission without manual clicking)
urlParameters.botPartner: Normalized partner name (e.g. 'HCL', 'Flebo.in', 'Medibuddy Drop-Off', 'Tatvacare', 'Dr. Morepen Labs', 'TGHS', 'Betacura', 'Allohealth', 'Bharath Home Medicare')
urlParameters.botCenter: Assigned lab center name (e.g. 'HCL - Sample drop', 'Medibuddy Drop-off', 'Dr. Morepen Labs')
urlParameters.botRow: Row number in the master Google Sheet to locate and mark upon completion
urlParameters.botCity: City name or sub-branch (e.g. 'Lucknow', 'Indore', 'Bhopal', 'Order History - VIT Bhopal')

faqs.question: Iframe blank kyu dikh raha hai ya page load kyu nahi ho raha?
faqs.answer:
Agar Bot Lab me iframe blank white dikh raha hai, iske 2 mukhya kaaran ho sakte hain:
1. Chrome Extension Status: Confirm karein ki 'Bisht Ji Ultimate Bot v10.2' extension enabled hai (chrome://extensions). Ye extension X-Frame-Options headers ko remove karti hai.
2. External Window Bypass (Instant Solution): Tab card ke upar ya Omnibox me 'Open in External Window' (open_in_new) button par click karein. Ye exact booking ko direct Chrome window me open kar dega jisme extension bina kisi restriction ke 100% fast chalegi.

faqs.question: Saari bookings ek saath kaise banayein (Bulk Parallel Mode)?
faqs.answer:
Saari bookings ek saath banane ke liye:
1. Bot Lab toolbar me '⚡ All at Once' mode select karein.
2. Active Pendency chip (jaise 'All Pending' ya client chip) par click karein, ya '📋 Pending Matrix' drawer open karke '⚡ Launch All in Multi-Tabs' dabayein.
3. Dashboard sabhi bookings ko separate tabs me open karega aur automatically Grid View (side-by-side 2x2) me set kar dega jisse saari bookings ek saath parallelly run hongi!

faqs.question: Ek-ek karke booking kaise karein (Single-Single / Sequential Mode)?
faqs.answer:
Single single bookings execute karne ke liye:
1. Toolbar me '🔁 1-by-1 Queue' mode select karein.
2. Kisi bhi chip par click karein. Dashboard ek interactive Queue HUD show karega jisme progress bar aur Skip/Pause/Window buttons honge.
3. Jaise hi pehli booking complete hogi, bot automatically agle patient par move karega, ya aap 'Skip to Next' click kar sakte hain.
4. Kisi specific patient ki akele booking banani ho toh 'Pending Matrix' drawer me uske row ke aage '⚡ Tab' ya '↗ Window' par click karein!

faqs.question: Morepen Labs ki booking me error kyu aata hai aur kaise fix karein?
faqs.answer: Dr. Morepen Labs me partner name hamesha 'Dr. Morepen Labs' hota hai. VIT Bhopal branch ke liye bot automatically 'Order History - VIT Bhopal' select karta hai aur address match karta hai. Agar portal me dropdown na dikhe, toh 'Open in External Window' karein jisme pre-seeded address mapping activate ho jayegi.

faqs.question: Quality Control (QC) me sample reject hone ke kya reasons hain?
faqs.answer: Standard 8 rejection reasons: Clotted Sample, Hemolysed Sample, Insufficient Volume (QNS), Label Mismatch, Wrong Tube / Additive, Leaked / Damaged Vial, Lipemic Sample, aur Delayed Transit (>24h cold chain failure).

faqs.question: Delivery Challan kaise print aur generate karein?
faqs.answer: Challan generate karne ke liye top rail par Challan tab (Key 6) par jayein. Dispatch hone wale samples select karein, Destination Lab chunein aur 'Generate & Print Challan' click karein. Barcoded printable manifest instant load ho jayega.

faqs.question: Dashboard ka data kitni der me refresh hota hai?
faqs.answer: Dashboard automatically har 75 seconds me Google Sheets se sync hota hai. Agar aapko instant update chahiye toh top bar me Sync icon click karein ya keyboard se Shift + R dabayein.
